Delete your data

Last updated: 2026-11-22

PrivacyTermsSupportDelete your data

Silkline has no accounts and no server of ours that stores your data, so there is no account to delete. Everything the app keeps is on your own device, and you control it.

On your phone

  • Your finds (photos, names, places, dates), your settings and your trial reminder are stored only on this phone. To delete them, open Silkline, go to Settings, tap Delete my finds and settings and confirm. Uninstalling the app also removes them, as does Android Settings, Apps, Silkline, Storage, Clear data.
  • Our service does not store your photo. It keeps only a random install ID with daily counters (deleted the next day) and, if you ever subscribed, your Pro status for up to 30 days after the paid period ends. An optional result report (no photo, no install ID) is kept for 90 days.

Data held by other companies

RevenueCat keeps your anonymous purchase record under its own policy. To ask about it, or to ask us to pass a deletion request on, email us.

Questions or requests

Email rizwanrasheed046@gmail.com and we will answer within 30 days. See also the privacy policy.
